custom.memory_above_system_limits: You are launching Minecraft with $XMX$ of allocated RAM, which exceeds your total available system memory ($TOTAL_CAPACITY$ including Swap). The game will be very unstable and prone to crashing. Please reduce your allocated memory.
custom.memory_below_recommended: You are launching Minecraft with $XMX$ of allocated RAM. The modpack should be able to run, but you may encounter some freezing and slowness, especially after keeping the game open for a long time. If your system can support it, visit your launcher settings and increase your memory allocation to $RECOMMENDED$ GB for a more stable experience.
custom.memory_below_minimum: You are launching Minecraft with only $XMX$ of allocated RAM. That is not enough for this modpack, and you will experience long or indefinite load times, freezing, and crashes. Please visit your launcher settings and allocate at least $MINIMUM$ GB, ideally $RECOMMENDED$ GB.
custom.high_system_load: You are launching Minecraft with $XMX$ of allocated RAM, but it seems your system memory is heavily loaded by other applications. The amount of available memory ($AVAILABLE$) is less than what Minecraft might still need to reach its limit. Please close unnecessary applications (like browsers or other games) to prevent freezes and crashes.
custom.memory_above_maximum: You are launching Minecraft with $XMX$ of allocated RAM. This is over the recommended amount so you may experience lag spikes. This modpack typically uses $RECOMMENDED$ GB, and we recommend you reduce your allocation to $RECOMMENDED$-$MAXIMUM$ GB.
